newsitem.title: GHANA: Ghana stocks end lower, interim results awaited.
newsitem.headline: Ghana stocks end lower, interim results awaited.

text.p: The Ghana stock exchange ended marginally lower on Friday after another quiet session as operators waited for interim company results, dealers said.
The GSE all-share index dipped 1.4 points to 385.02.

"Market sentiment has been bearish throughout the week, with players rather cautious in waiting for some indication as to company half-yearly performance. The situation is likely to continue for some time," one dealer said.
Pioneer Aluminium Factory added 20 cedis to 150 and Mechanical Lloyd was up 15 at 110.
Ghana Commercial Bank fell 20 to 550. It was weak last month when investors sold stock in disappointment at the 1996 dividend, but dealers said earlier this week it was looking steadier.
Volume was a low 107,650 shares. -- Alan Raybould, Abidjan newsroom +225 21 90 90
